brightloop.example.name: Brightloop
brightloop.example.page: Brightloop builds customer onboarding software for B2B SaaS teams. Our product guides new users through setup with in-app checklists. We serve 400 customers across Europe. We are a sales-led company and our outbound team books most of our demos.

signals.text: is hiring 4 new Sales Development Representatives for its outbound team
announced an expansion into the German and French markets

fjordline.example.name: Fjordline Growth
fjordline.example.page: Fjordline Growth is an outbound agency. We run LinkedIn and email prospecting campaigns for 30 B2B clients. Our team builds target account lists every week for each client.

signals.text: launched a new LinkedIn outbound service for SaaS startups

vectorpay.example.name: Vectorpay
